title_as_printed: Results for the system containing approx. 1 mol Na2SO4/kg H2O

value.note: set per block by label row: xCO2 = overall liquid composition at the bubble point (stated whether salt-free basis: not stated; computed by authors from weighed amounts, salt apparently counted as undissociated component or on water basis not stated)

uncertainty.note: set per block by label row

composition.note: Na2SO4 molality is set per block by the label row (group_rows).

conversion_needs: Each row is one bubble point at fixed overall composition: x is the block constant, P and T are the measured pair. Not an isotherm.
